inclusions.source: This is a group journey: a scheduled departure travelling together as one party, with a shared, licensed Egyptologist guide and private air-conditioned transport throughout.

inclusions.text: Meet at Cairo International Airport, assistance and transfer to the hotel
inclusions.source: The group is met at Cairo International Airport, assisted through arrival formalities, and transferred directly to the hotel.

inclusions.text: Day 1 dinner, depending on arrival time
inclusions.source: Dinner is included or not depending on the arrival time.

inclusions.text: Lunch provided during the Day 2 tour
inclusions.source: Lunch is provided during the tour; return to the hotel for dinner.

inclusions.text: 3 nights on the Nile and 2 nights on the Red Sea
inclusions.source: - Character · Scheduled group departure · shared licensed Egyptologist guide · 3 nights on the Nile and 2 nights on the Red Sea · soft arrival, sea-pause before the close

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.source: Meals: Dinner, depending on arrival time Overnight: Cairo

itinerary.title: The Grand Egyptian Museum and the Pyramids of Giza
itinerary.source: The tour then continues onto the plateau itself: the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and the Great Sphinx.

itinerary.title: Old Cairo, Islamic Cairo and Khan el-Khalili
itinerary.source: After breakfast, the day turns from the pharaonic city to the medieval one.

itinerary.title: Fly to Aswan and Board the Nile Cruise
itinerary.source: After breakfast, transfer to Cairo Airport for the domestic flight south to Aswan.

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo and Sailing North
itinerary.source: The ship then continues toward Edfu.

itinerary.title: Edfu and Sailing to Luxor
itinerary.source: Back aboard, the ship continues toward Luxor, and the rest of the day is at leisure on deck.

itinerary.title: Luxor and the Drive to the Red Sea
itinerary.source: Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner Overnight: Hurghada

itinerary.title: Hurghada: The Red Sea
itinerary.source: Meals: Breakfast and dinner, per the hotel's board basis Overnight: Hurghada

itinerary.title: Fly to Cairo and the Citadel
itinerary.source: After breakfast, transfer to Hurghada Airport for the flight back to Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.source: After breakfast and check-out, transfer to Cairo International Airport for the onward flight.
